تتعاطوا (form VI)
# تَتَعَاطَوْا (tataʕāṭaw) /ta.ta.ʕaː.tˤaw/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَعَاطَى (taʕāṭā)
# تُتَعَاطَوْا (tutaʕāṭaw) /tu.ta.ʕaː.tˤaw/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَعَاطَى (taʕāṭā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
